content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit www.echs.gov.in and click on "Employment Opportunities". Download the application form and the terms and conditions. Fill in the application form in the prescribed format. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials supporting educational qualifications and work experience. Prepare the application in triplicate . Send it so that it reaches the OIC, Station HQ (ECHS Cell), by 14 October 2026 . Candidates applying for Clerk and DEO posts under the Ex-servicemen category must register with AWPO and enclose the AWPO Registration Slip with the application.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the qualitative requirement will be called for an interview at Station HQ on 02 November 2026. For the posts of Clerk and DEO, a written test and a computer practical test will also be conducted. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen, Widows of Service Personnel and Veer Naris. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ECHS Interview
content_sections.text: Bring the following original documents to the interview, and submit 3 copies of the application along with self-attested copies of the documents: Certificates and mark sheets of 10th/Matric, 10+2 and Graduation/Post Graduation/Diploma/Course MD/MS certificate in the specialty concerned (for specialist posts) Work Experience Certificate Medical Fitness Certificate duly signed by CMO/SEMO Character Certificate duly signed by Tehsildar Discharge Book and PPO (for Ex-servicemen) AWPO Registration Slip (for Ex-servicemen applying for Clerk and DEO)

content_sections.heading: On-Job Training (OJT) for Key Appointments
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for Medical Specialist, Radiologist, Gynaecologist and Medical Officer must complete 10 days of On-Job Training and obtain a certificate from the OIC Polyclinic before taking charge and signing the contract. The OJT period will remain unpaid.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual: 1 year for Ex-servicemen and 11 months for civil candidates. The contract can be renewed for an additional year, or until the candidate reaches the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions. Applications received after 14 October 2026 will not be accepted. Candidates must reach Station HQ by 0900 hrs on 02 November 2026 with original documents. No TA/DA is admissible. Apply only for posts for which you meet the qualitative requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) to hire medical, paramedical, and non-medical staff on a contractual basis across multiple polyclinics in India.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 23 vacancies available across various posts including Radiologist, Gynaecologist, Medical Specialist, Medical Officer, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, and supporting staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application form from the official website and send the hard copy in triplicate via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The final date for the receipt of completed applications at the designated Station Headquarters is 14 October 2026. Applications received after this date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q5. What is the scheduled date for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates who successfully submit their offline applications is scheduled to take place on 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary varies depending on the specific post, ranging from Rs. 21,800/- per month for support staff up to Rs. 1,30,000/- per month for specialist medical officers.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or requested in the official recruitment notification released by the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a written test, a computer practical test where applicable, and a final personal interview conducted by the selection board.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit their applications in triplicate along with self-attested photocopies of all required testimonials to Station HQ (ECHS Cell) Yol by the stipulated deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly by visiting the official website of the organization at www.echs.gov.in.
